# Zelta Design, full site content

> Zelta Design is a full-service architecture firm in Nutley, New Jersey, specializing in restaurant and commercial projects. The firm has completed over 1,000 projects for +40 brands and is licensed in 25 states. It handles a project end to end: site survey, schematic design, construction documents, permitting and plan review, code and accessibility compliance, MEP coordination and construction administration.
> Generated from the site's own data. Every project below links to its page.

## Firm

- Sector focus: quick-service restaurants, fast casual, cafes, and commercial tenant fit-outs

## Projects

### Dave's Hot Chicken - White Plains, NY

Dave's Hot Chicken in White Plains, New York was designed by Zelta Design. Full-height murals, graffiti artwork and neon signage define the dining room. Red exposed ductwork and metal chairs accompany concrete floors and wood wainscoting.

Address: 489 Tarrytown Road, White Plains, NY 10607. Floor area: 4,060 sq ft.

Source: https://www.zeltadesign.com/project/daves-hot-chicken-white-plains/

### Dave's Hot Chicken - Sumter, SC

Dave's Hot Chicken in Sumter, South Carolina was designed by Zelta Design. This freestanding restaurant includes a drive-thru and covered patio. The dining room combines full-height murals, exposed red ductwork and wood tabletops. The layout separates dine-in, pickup and drive-thru orders.

Address: 1135 Broad St., Sumter, SC 29150. Floor area: 3,110 sq ft.

Source: https://www.zeltadesign.com/project/daves-hot-chicken-sumter/

### Popeyes - Times Square, NY

Popeyes in Times Square, New York was designed by Zelta Design. Located in the heart of Times Square, this Popeyes flagship location has many unique elements. The building's exterior features a modern and sleek design with a large glass façade that would allow passersby to see inside. When arriving to the second floor (either by stairs or an elevator) guests are greeted by a spacious and open floor plan with ample seating options. The restaurant features a mix of booths and tables, as well as a bar-style seating area. To ensure efficient service, the restaurant has a state-of-the-art food transporter system that seamlessly transports food from the kitchen to the second floor seating area of the restaurant. The building is designed to maximize efficiency and customer satisfaction while also offering a visually stunning dining experience that will leave a lasting impression on guests.

Address: 1530 Broadway, New York, NY 10036. Program: flagship.

Source: https://www.zeltadesign.com/project/popeyes/
